items.title: Pay doctor's invoice
items.quote: Bitte begleichen Sie den Rechnungsbetrag innerhalb von 30 Tagen nach dem Rechnungsdatum unter Angabe der Rechnungsnummer.
items.computation: Private invoice, period counted under §§ 187, 188, 193 BGB. Start event is the invoice date 26.06.2026; this day is not counted (§187 Abs.1 BGB). Counting 30 days forward: day 1 = 27.06.2026 ... day 30 = 26.07.2026. 26.07.2026 is a Sunday, so under §193 BGB the due date moves to the next working day. This is a payment to a private company, so the relevant holidays are those of the payer's own Land (NW per given context); no public holiday falls on 27.07.2026, which is a Monday, so it becomes the due date.
